name: Infotmic Co., Ltd.
summary: Infotmic Co., Ltd. specializes in the design and sale of integrated circuit chips, alongside serving as a distributor for electronic components. Its product portfolio encompasses various semiconductor offerings, including application processors and image processors. The company further provides solutions for video, intelligent, and entertainment terminals, as well as industrial devices. The electronic components it distributes are widely utilized across sectors such as internet communication, automotive digital systems, smart wearable technology, and consumer electronics. Infotmic Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Shanghai, People's Republic of China.
